title: Schema drift investigator scratchpad
body:
Quick context:
- Intermittent failures in downstream schema validator when handling tool invocation responses (only in streaming path; non-streaming OK).
- Symptoms: final parse errors or extra-key warnings reported by customers using Dedicated. Happened ~2% of requests since 2026-02-01.

Reproduction notes (manual):
1) curl against local proxy to simulate streaming chunks:
   curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer TEST' \\n     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate \\n     -d '{"model":"demo-serve","input":"call_tool:weather?city=oakland","stream":true}'
   -> watch for SSE/data chunks containing partial JSON fields

2) Python quick repro (requests, chunked read):
   r = requests.post(url, json=payload, stream=True)
   for chunk in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
       if chunk:
           # chunk looks like: 'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"tool_result":"{\n"}}]}'
           buffer += strip_sse_prefix(chunk)
           try:
               parsed = json.loads(buffer)
           except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
               # inspect buffer length & last bytes
               pass

Observed error snippets (from logs):
- JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 456 (char 455)
- ValidatorWarning: extra keys in object: ['debug_meta']
- downstream: schema mismatch at path $.tool_output -- type: string expected: object

Notable raw fragments captured from streaming sessions: (sanitized)
- chunk A: 'data: {"id":"abc","choices":[{"delta":{"tool_result":"{\"temperature\": 64,\n\"humidity\": 72\"}"}}]}'  <-- missing closing brace in inner JSON due to chunk boundary
- chunk B: 'data: {"id":"abc","choices":[{"delta":{"tool_result":"}\n"}}]}'  <-- boundary split causing '}{' merge problem when concatenating naive buffers

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Streaming chunk boundary insertion: we naively concat SSE lines without properly handling escaped quotes / nested JSON inside strings. When tool_result is itself JSON-serialized string, inner quotes + newlines get split and lead to invalid outer JSON until final chunk.
2) Model-side emission sometimes wraps tool_result as an encoded JSON string vs. raw object (inconsistent schema from model/template). Schema drift between model variants or tokenization causing double-encoding.
3) Our SSE prefix stripping code removes only the first 'data: ' instance on a line; some chunks contain multiple 'data: ' frames and we join them into a single buffer without separators.
4) Upstream router occasionally injects debug_meta (extra key) which validator rejects; could be a middleware adding per-request debug info for internal tenants.

Quick experiments I ran locally:
- Turned on strict chunk framing in proxy: require each data: frame to be processed independently and emit a delimiter between concatenations -> reduced errors in local replay from 12 failures / 1000 -> 0 / 1000 for the synthetic traffic. Promising but not full fix (edge cases remain).
- Replayed customer request with and without 'compact' model parameter: compact=false produced structured objects; compact=true produced string-encoded JSON inside tool_result. Suggests a model/template differerence.
- Added a pre-parse attempt: if tool_result is string, try json.loads(tool_result) and accept both forms. That reduces validator errors but masks root cause.

Short-term mitigations (proposed):
- Patch proxy to treat each SSE frame as an atomic unit and avoid merging frames; always trim leading/trailing whitespace before concatenation. (PR opened: runtime#987)
- Add tolerant parsing layer in Console ingestion: accept both object and string forms for tool_result and normalize to canonical object before passing to strict validator.
- Add server-side test vectors for chunked nested JSON to CI (replay 1000 synthetic streams).

Longer-term fixes / things to investigate:
- Confirm whether model templates differ across model family/variants (compare prompts for hosted vs dedicated images). If template changes are causing double-encoding, coordinate with model-onboarding to lock format.
- Add a clear contract for tool outputs in API docs: tool_result must be a JSON object (not string) and streaming must not split tokens inside JSON tokens without escaping guidance.
- Instrument production to capture 1% of raw streaming frames (ring buffer) for failed requests so we can inspect exact chunk boundaries without PII.

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Is debug_meta injection intentional? Who owns that middleware? @Elena to check SRE logs.
- [ ] Add a unit test that simulates an inner JSON split across SSE frames. (owner: me)
- [ ] Evaluate performance impact of per-frame atomic processing on latency. (SRE)
- [ ] Add Linear ticket with customer repro (INF-234) and attach sanitized raw frames.

Notes to self: avoid quick band-aids that make validators tolerant forever. Prefer normalization layers that log anomalies and raise alerts so model/template drift gets fixed at source.

Appendix: small helper I used for sane SSE parsing (pseudo):

def parse_sse_line(line, buffer):
    # strip 'data:' prefixes that may appear multiple times
    frames = [f.strip() for f in line.split('data:') if f.strip()]
    for f in frames:
        # try parse immediately; if fails, append to buffer and continue
        try:
            obj = json.loads(f)
            yield obj
            buffer = ''
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            buffer += f
            # if buffer grows beyond threshold, alert and reset
            if len(buffer) > 64*1024:
                alert('huge_buffer')
                buffer = ''
    return buffer

-- end scratchpad --
summary: Investigating intermittent schema/JSON errors from streaming tool responses; initial fixes reduce errors by treating SSE frames atomically and adding a tolerant normalization layer. Next: add CI vectors and determine if model template differences are root cause.
